title: Hanasato Minori — Moved Beyond Words〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
It feels like it's been forever since we last practiced here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, that's right. Ever since you girls set up the MORE MORE HOUSE, you've been practicing over there.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We want Shizuku to have it to herself right now, so we're gonna do what we can here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Still, I sorta couldn't believe it when she said that she has to practice like nothing else matters to measure up to that other girl.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <She's appearing alongside one of the girls who did that collaborative performance with all of you at Idol Lovers, right? What was her name? Uhh...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I did think that her stage presence during Idol Lovers was amazing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Shizuku went on to say...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“I'm afraid that I'm going to ruin this commercial.”
She even said Hagiyama possesses something that she doesn't, and that she might not have what it takes...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <She really said those things? But she used to be a model...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku always practices really hard and works a lot on her own, but things feel different this time around.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When I saw her practicing over at the MORE MORE HOUSE, she gave me goosebumps.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She actually reminded me of when I met her for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <When you met her for the very first time?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A quiet and gentle girl, but she had a ton of presence. My eyes were naturally drawn to her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've thought a lot about how I could become an idol who shines the way she does...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And the answer seems to be what she's doing now. Figuring out how to best present herself by putting in the time and effort.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Her charm is the result of all the work she's put in up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <She's mentioned how she worked harder than anyone else in Cheerful * Days as the lead, in order to live up to everybody's expectations.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly. Everyone talks about how tall and beautiful Shizuku is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But those things aren't enough to become the lead. You need more than that to shine the way she does!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (So amazing that I couldn't take my eyes off you.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If I went to audition for something and found out that I'd be performing alongside a person like Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But you're here right now for a reason, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If I'm not good enough the way I am, I'll just work until I am good enough!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As Shizuku's groupmate, I have to do what I can to not embarrass her!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's what I like to hear, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We had a feeling that you two had come over to talk to Minori.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Thank goodness we found you.
We were hoping to invite you two as well.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The idea is to hold a sort of mock audition where we compete against one another by singing and dancing and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: KAITO's come up with the details for each event, so we're all set to go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wanna give it a try, Minori?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Excellent! Then, let's meet over in SEKAI!>
